name: firewall_remaining
command: iptables -S SCL_IP_ACCEPT; ip6tables -S SCL_IP_ACCEPT_V6; ip6tables -S SCL_IP_DROP_V6; iptables -S secondary_lan_in

name: mtd_writeability
command: printf "rootfs_flags="; cat /sys/class/mtd/mtd0/flags; printf "log_flags="; cat /sys/class/mtd/mtd7/flags; printf "config_flags="; cat /sys/class/mtd/mtd2/flags

name: ssh_settings
command: printf 'ssh_enabled='; cfgcmd get InternetGatewayDevice.Services.ServiceSSH.Enable; printf '\nssh_port='; cfgcmd get InternetGatewayDevice.Services.ServiceSSH.Port; printf '\n'

name: boot_commandline
command: tr ' ' '\n' < /proc/cmdline | awk '/^(console=|root=|rootfstype=|ro$|rw$|mtdparts=)/ {if ($0 ~ /^mtdparts=/) print "mtdparts present, mapping withheld";else print}'
